The present bail application is filed on behalf of the petitioner Ajay Kumar Yadav under section 438 Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail in FIR bearing no. 0499/2022 registered under sections 498A/406/34 IPC and the charge sheet was filed under sections 498A/406/376 IPC at P.S.
Samaipur Badli.
2. The Additonal Public Prosecutor being assisted by Investigating Officer stated that the petitioner has joined and participated in the investigation.
The charge sheet has already been filed in FIR bearing no. 0499/2022 without arrest of the petitioner.

3. After considering all facts, the petitioner in case of arrest either by the Investigating Officer or by the trial court shall be admitted to bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the
